subHeader: Are you interested in scouting and sailing? Then you should register your interest with HSS.
description: Regardless of whether you are 8 years old or 100 years old, you are welcome. To register for the waiting list, please fill out the interest form below. We will contact you when a spot becomes available.
description3: We work to ensure that everyone feels safe and included at HSS. Our operations are built on community, joy and mutual respect.
